# AKYIN Ventures (akyin.com)

> Multi-business corporate group and standalone marketing service marketplace operating core ventures across digital marketing, automotive dealership growth, publishing, and fashion retail while supporting 58+ client businesses across India and the UAE.

## Corporate & Core Pages

- [Home — AKYIN Ventures](https://akyin.com/): Corporate overview, operating verticals, verified client portfolio ticker, standalone pricing highlights, and direct enquiry gateway.
- [About Us & FAQs](https://akyin.com/about): Corporate profile, group architecture, 16-year commercial track record, security standards, and frequently asked questions.
- [Our Businesses Directory](https://akyin.com/ventures): Portfolio comparison across AKYIN Ventures and featured client platforms.
- [Standalone Service Pricing & Quotation Builder](https://akyin.com/pricing): Transparent INR pricing across all 10 standalone service categories and custom quotation builder.
- [Business, Marketing & Sales Calculators Suite](https://akyin.com/tools): 20 free interactive calculators for ROI, ROAS, CAC, CPL, break-even, GST, margins, commissions, quotation estimation, and advisory booking.
- [Business Advisory Booking](https://akyin.com/advisory): Schedule a 1-on-1 business advisory consultation on India Standard Time (Asia/Kolkata).
- [Insights & Business Philosophy](https://akyin.com/insights): Operational essays on publishing, dealership lead qualification, retail, and digital platforms.
- [Contact Us](https://akyin.com/contact): Structured enquiry desk with instant WhatsApp and email draft generation.
- [Terms of Service](https://akyin.com/terms): Commercial engagement terms, direct platform billing policy, and advisory disclaimers.
- [Privacy Policy](https://akyin.com/privacy): Visitor data protection, CSP safeguards, and zero-broker enquiry handling.
- [Site Map](https://akyin.com/sitemap): Full index of internal routes, standalone service pages (`/services/:slug`), and verified external domains.

## Operating Verticals & Showcased Client Platforms

- [AKYIN Publishing](https://akyin.com/ventures/publishing): Independent publishing featuring eight Amazon books (*The Discipline Code*, *BIOPIC OF LOSER*, *The Scroll Recovery Plan*, *The Wealth Trap*, *The Reset Code*, *The Discipline Reset*, *The Overthinking Reset*, *The Dopamine Reset Code*), three Gumroad digital productivity kits (*ATS Resume Kit*, *The Scroll Recovery Plan*, *The Money OS*), Google Play Books, and Pinterest.
- [AKYIN MARKETINGS (Standalone Service Marketplace)](https://akyin.com/ventures/marketing): 10 modular service categories spanning Automotive Marketing, Digital Marketing, Social Media Management, Creative & Graphic Design, Video & Content, Business Documents & Presentations, Excel & Reporting, Messaging & Communication, Lead Management & CRM, and Business Consulting & Training.
- [AKYIN Automotive Marketing Division](https://akyin.com/marketing/automotive): Specialized standalone services for car dealerships, test-drive lead generation, showroom launch camps, ROI calculators, and showroom sales training.
- [AKYIN Store · AKYIN THRIFT](https://akyin.com/ventures/store): Curated men's and women's discounted fashion apparel retail.
- [AICalc.in](https://akyin.com/ventures/aicalc): Natural-language AI calculation and manual calculator platform ([aicalc.in](https://aicalc.in)).
- [Kartigo.online](https://akyin.com/ventures/kartigo): B2B wholesale stock supply and commercial trade platform ([kartigo.online](https://kartigo.online)).
- [BizNXT.online](https://akyin.com/ventures/biznxt): Entrepreneur business clarity, feasibility, and consulting ([biznxt.online](https://biznxt.online)).
- [Budget Bazaar](https://akyin.com/ventures/budget-bazaar): Value-first everyday household goods retail ([budgetbazaar.org](https://budgetbazaar.org)).

## Key Standalone Service Pages (`/services/:slug`) & Transparent Pricing Highlights (INR)

Every service at AKYIN MARKETINGS is standalone—zero compulsory bundles:

- **Automotive Dealership Marketing & Sales Strategy** (`/services/automotive-marketing`): ₹50,000/session
- **Online Lead Generation Campaigns** (`/services/lead-generation`): Custom quote on request
- **Lead Filtering & Qualification** (`/services/lead-filtering`): ₹24,000/month
- **Meta Ads Management** (`/services/meta-ads-management`): ₹40,000/month (ad spend paid directly by client)
- **Logo Design** (`/services/logo-design`): ₹6,000 project / ₹10,000 monthly
- **YouTube Thumbnail Design** (`/services/youtube-thumbnail-design`): ₹3,000 (5-pack) / ₹8,000 monthly
- **Script Writing** (`/services/script-writing`): ₹4,000 (3-pack) / ₹12,000 monthly
- **PowerPoint Presentation Design** (`/services/presentation-design`): ₹6,000 (12 slides) / ₹14,000 monthly
- **Excel Reports & Automation** (`/services/excel-reporting`): ₹5,000 report / ₹10,000 monthly
- **Bulk SMS Marketing** (`/services/bulk-sms`): ₹3,000 for 10,000 SMS credits (₹0.30/SMS; extra credits configurable by admin)
- **WhatsApp Business Messaging Setup** (`/services/whatsapp-business-setup`): ₹4,999 one-time setup (strictly separate from ₹1.50/message usage)
- **1-on-1 Business Advisory Consultation (30 min IST)** (`https://akyin.com/advisory`): ₹3,998 per session

> Messaging disclaimer: Messaging rates are subject to provider charges, applicable taxes, message category, destination and delivery conditions. Final charges are confirmed in the quotation.
